_comment: Non-secret test data for the designed retail suite. scripts/test_data.py merges this with the shopper-account secrets and per-run unique values into .testmuai/variables/ci.json. Add a key here when preflight reports a variable no one supplies.
_comment_malformed: The store's email inputs are type=email, so an address without @ is blocked by the browser and the store never shows its own field error. shopper@example passes the browser and is rejected by the store: 'E-Mail Address does not appear to be valid!'.
